requestedIntent: Prevent one delivery objective from resetting ceremony budgets through renamed runs, repeated replans, per-finding manual-QA lifecycles, or stale temporary-worktree installations while preserving fail-closed treatment of critical defects.

docs: CHANGELOG.md#Parent-objective supervision stops cross-run ceremony loops

limitations: The source capability is enforced but remains unproven until a controlled real delivery shows fewer runs and replans without an increase in escaped defects.
The 15/30-minute progress watchdog counts bounded intervals between objective state observations and caps each idle gap at five minutes; it does not treat laptop sleep as active delivery time.
Existing active runs that predate installation remain compatibility-readable. The next new run must bind a parent objective and pass the worktree freshness handshake.
Thresholds are evidence-informed defaults from one pathological objective and require canary calibration before maturity can advance to proven.

evidence.note: Counterfactual lifecycle proves consolidation at run five, manual-QA completion and explicit batching before repair, critical concurrency escalation, refusal before run eight, suspension after five replans, source-worktree drift refusal, and installed-runtime tamper refusal.
Proves schema/runtime installation metadata and refresh of both root and linked Git worktrees.
